cells.gaps: No source says hubs with programmes run in a second city: the Kabale, Soroti, Muni and Busitema hubs are named with no programme described. No technology park with tenants is on record.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-13: the ministry reports the National ICT Innovation Hub at Nakawa, reopened in January 2024, supported 133 start-ups and took 102 products to market (UGA-005), so a hub runs programmes. The hubs in other towns have no programme on record, so not 4.
